reasoning_content:
Since `web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile` is a symlink to `/workspace/profile`, editing `profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml` will reflect the changes in the web docroot as well.

Alright, let's apply the fix: add `- 'geocoder:geocoder'` to the dependencies.

action.command:
cd /workspace
sed -i "s|^  - 'ctools:ctools'$|  - 'ctools:ctools'\n  - 'geocoder:geocoder'|" profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml
echo "=== updated deps ==="
sed -n '/^dependencies:/,/^[a-z_]*:/p' profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml | head
echo "=== git diff ==="
git diff profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml
